The platform integrates user autonomy tools; specifically, from the Settings section, you can execute the permanent and irreversible deletion of your entire account and all linked records, without requiring administrative intervention on our part.

security.title: 4. Security and Integrity
security.content: The integrity of your data is guaranteed by the security architecture of Firebase (Google Cloud Platform), which has international certifications for encryption both in transit and at rest.
